messages:
mika: Quick sync — I sketched a new synthetic traffic generator config to repro the regression we saw last week (kernel fallback + long-tail from KV cold misses). Need quick eyeballs before I implement the harness.

mika: Problem summary: on sustained ~700 qps with 20% epsilon microbursts (1–2s spikes to 3-4k qps) we sometimes hit a kernel-selection path that degrades batching and causes 99.9 latency spikes. The KV miss tail amplifies it because many requests probe cold prefixes.

alex: SGTM. Two quick asks: 1) can the generator emulate KV key churn (TTL-based expiry) so we get realistic cold miss churn? 2) include a mode for replaying real request size / prompt-length histograms for apples-to-apples.

sam: +1 on TTL churn. Also we should vary prefix overlap. In production a lot of prefixes share the same 1-3 tokens so KV cache hit rate isn't independent. Have a param to set prefix entropy.

jordan: To match kernel-selection triggers we need to capture sequence length distribution and real-time windowed QPS. Kernel picks change if active batch sizes shift distribution quickly. Add a rolling qps window and a spike ramp rate parameter.

mika: Draft config (high-level) — want feedback on knobs:

```
{
  "base_qps": 700,
  "burst_profile": {
    "burst_fraction": 0.2,
    "burst_peak_multiplier": 5,
    "burst_duration_ms": [500, 2000],
    "ramp_up_ms": 50,
    "ramp_down_ms": 200
  },
  "seq_len_histogram": "imported_from_prod.json",
  "prefix_entropy": 0.35,        # 0 low diversity, 1 random
  "kv": {
    "key_space": 500000,
    "working_set": 20000,
    "ttl_ms": 300000,
    "churn_mode": "poisson",   # or "sweep", "zipf"
    "cold_miss_suffix_prob": 0.12
  },
  "replay_mode": "hybrid",     # synthetic + replay traces
  "kernel_probe_interval_s": 10
}
```

mika: The idea: baseline QPS with intermittent microbursts, controlled prefix entropy to tune KV hit correlation, TTL churn to trigger cold misses, and ability to overlay actual trace-derived seq-len hist to force kernel-path parity.

kemal: For apples-to-apples, we must also match client-side concurrency distribution. If our generator opens N long-lived connections vs lots of short ones, kernel batching behavior differs. Add a concurrency_shard param.

alex: Also capture inter-request spacing jitter — not purely Poisson. Real traces show periodic clustering at ~100ms granularity due to upstream batching. Add a clustered Poisson option.

sam: For the KV warmup experiment: run 3 phases: 1) cold sweep (0% working set cached), 2) steady-state (let TTLs stabilize), 3) targeted churn (hotset rotates). Compare 99/99.9 latency and kernel selection traces across phases.

perf-bot: /profile-run scheduled: generator:3456789012-configA on cluster-stage-3. Expected duration 30m. Attach flamegraph link: https://perf.example/reports/3456789012

jordan: When you collect profiles, capture these metrics: kernel_id timeline, batch_size histogram (per 100ms), kv_hit_rate (prefix-level), queue_wait_ms, and tail_rpc_retries. That lets us correlate kernel handoffs to rising queue_wait.

mika: Plan for experiments:
- implement TTL churn + prefix entropy
- add replay overlay for seq-len & client concurrency
- implement burst shapes: sawtooth, gaussian pulse, abrupt spike
- instrument kernel selection events in runtime and export as a time-series

mika: Example CLI to run a hybrid test:

```
./synthgen --config configs/hybrid-ttl-pulse.json --duration 1800 --outdir /tmp/runs/3456789012
# then
./replay-harness compare --gold /tmp/gold/run-2025-06-21 --candidate /tmp/runs/3456789012 --metrics kernels,batches,kv
```

kemal: One more: add an option to pin model variant list so fallback paths are deterministic. Otherwise autoscaling/fallback confounds apples-to-apples.

alex: Good catch. Also we should include an "entropy seed" in configs so runs are reproducible.

mika: Questions for team:
1) Are these knobs sufficient to trigger the regression reliably? (kernel fallback + KV tail)
2) Any missing observability signals we should export from the runtime for correlation?
3) Volunteers to own impl + infra for running nightly stress matrix?

sam: I can take the TTL churn + prefix entropy implementation.

jordan: I'll wire kernel selection telemetry and batch histograms into the metrics exporter.

alex: I'll own the replay overlay and the apples-to-apples comparison tooling.

mika: Perfect. I'll glue the generator CLI and create the matrix (burst shapes x entropy x ttl) and kick off runs. Assigning a quick follow-up doc in docs/perf once we have first reproducible case.

devops-bot: FYI cluster-stage-3 has a maintenance window 2025-07-02T03:00-04:00 UTC. Schedule tests outside that.

mika: noted. Thanks all — I'll start PR and tag reviewers. :thumbsup:
